title: Data & BI Intern
description: Data & BI Intern Location: Amsterdam (Hybrid) Work model: Internship Team: MOVION Data Team About Movion Movion helps digital brands reach and grow audiences through mobile networks around the world. We bring together performance marketing, technology, content and local payment solutions to turn great digital products into successful subscription businesses. With more than 16 years of mobile expertise and activity in over 45 markets, we work across everything from user acquisition and creative campaigns to payment integrations and revenue optimisation. We also build and distribute our own digital products in gaming, fitness, learning, sports and entertainment. At Movion, you'll join an international, collaborative team where you can take ownership, learn from people across disciplines and see the impact of your work. The Role We're looking for a Data & BI Intern to join our growing Data Team. This internship offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle, from report planning and development to data transformation, validation and stakeholder communication. You'll work closely with experienced team members on real business projects, helping to build and improve data solutions that support decision-making across the business. reporting requirements and business needs Assist in improving existing reporting processes and data workflows Document data structures, reporting logic and processes where required Job Requirements
